raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: tracy
  build_number: 3
  version: "0.13.1"

recipe:
  name: tracy-profiler-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/wolfpld/${{ name }}/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.zip
  sha256: a1ecc73b0547512d4bab71278a14581763940118baef835a8033a675f3c8e06d
  patches:
    # Avoid linking issue on MacOS
    - patches/0001-Don-t-link-against-Python-library-in-Python-module.patch
    # Avoid linking issues on Linux with conda packages
    - patches/0002-Avoid-linking-issues-when-linking-against-conda-pack.patch
    # Don't retrieve git ref
    - patches/0003-Don-t-retrieve-git-ref.patch
    # Avoid to use pkg-config as most as possible
    # Some .pc file are not available on Windows
    - patches/0004-Use-find_package-instead-of-package-config-to-.patch
    # Use embed build in native mode and installed in path
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: patches/0005-Use-embed-installed-as-an-external-project.patch
    # Don't prompt about achievements in the GUI
    - patches/0007-Don-t-prompt-about-achievements.patch
    # Hide ghost zones by default in the GUI to reduce clutter
    - patches/0008-Hide-ghost-zones-by-default.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  # =====================
  # tracy-profiler-client
  # =====================
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler-client
    build:
      script:
        file: build_tracy_client
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
      run:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tracy-profiler-client', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - tracy/tracy/Tracy.hpp
          lib:
            - TracyClient
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check Tracy --targets TracyClient
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - cmake-package-check
  # ==================
  # tracy-profiler-gui
  # ==================
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler-gui
    build:
      skip: ppc64le or aarch64
      script:
        file: build_tracy_gui
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        # clang-scan-dep is needed to build cxx 20 module from plugixml
        - if: osx
          then: clang-tools
      host:
        - freetype
        # CMake doesn't find freetype without zlib
        - libcurl
        - zlib
        - glfw
        - if: linux
          then:
            - dbus
            - libegl-devel
            - xorg-libx11
        - if: linux or osx
          then: libcapstone
        - tbb-devel
      run:
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - tracy-profiler
      - script:
          - tracy-profiler --help
  # ======================
  # tracy-profiler-capture
  # ======================
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler-capture
    build:
      skip: ppc64le or aarch64
      script:
        file: build_tracy_capture
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        # clang-scan-dep is needed to build cxx 20 module from pugixml
        - if: osx
          then: clang-tools
      host:
        # cmake/vendor.cmake is included at configure time and requires the
        # full GUI dependency set (find_package REQUIRED) even though the CLI
        # tool only links against TracyServer + TracyGetOpt.
        # pugixml is added to avoid a CPM download and C++20 module scanning.
        - freetype
        - libcurl
        - zlib
        - glfw
        - if: linux
          then:
            - dbus
            - libegl-devel
            - xorg-libx11
        - if: linux or osx
          then: libcapstone
        - tbb-devel
        - pugixml
      run:
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - tracy-capture
  # ========================
  # tracy-profiler-csvexport
  # ========================
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler-csvexport
    build:
      skip: ppc64le or aarch64
      script:
        file: build_tracy_csvexport
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        # clang-scan-dep is needed to build cxx 20 module from pugixml
        - if: osx
          then: clang-tools
      host:
        # cmake/vendor.cmake is included at configure time and requires the
        # full GUI dependency set (find_package REQUIRED) even though the CLI
        # tool only links against TracyServer + TracyGetOpt.
        # pugixml is added to avoid a CPM download and C++20 module scanning.
        - freetype
        - libcurl
        - zlib
        - glfw
        - if: linux
          then:
            - dbus
            - libegl-devel
            - xorg-libx11
        - if: linux or osx
          then: libcapstone
        - tbb-devel
        - pugixml
      run:
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - tracy-csvexport
  # ============================
  # tracy-profiler-client-python
  # ============================
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler-client-python
    build:
      script:
        file: build_tracy_client_python
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        # clang-scan-dep is needed to build cxx 20 module
        - if: osx
          then: clang-tools
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - scikit-build-core
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tracy-profiler-client', exact=true) }}
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tracy-profiler-client', exact=true) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - tracy_client
      - python:
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          - if: win
            then: set TRACY_NO_INVARIANT_CHECK=1
            else: export TRACY_NO_INVARIANT_CHECK=1
          - python -c "import tracy_client"
  # ==============
  # tracy-profiler
  # ==============
  - package:
      name: tracy-profiler
    requirements:
      host:
        # Explicitly add a python requirement to change hash between python version
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tracy-profiler-client', exact=true) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tracy-profiler-client-python', exact=true) }}

about:
  summary: |
    A real time, nanosecond resolution, remote telemetry, hybrid frame and
    sampling profiler for games and other applications.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy
  repository: https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy

extra:
  feedstock-name: tracy-profiler
  recipe-maintainers:

    - jcarpent
